messages:
mina: Heads-up — onboarding quant-m38b-int4, seeing a reproducible divergence after ~8200 tokens where answers subtly shift and then repeat older tokens. Suspect RoPE compression/handshake with KV cache. :eyes;
jon: Can you paste a minimal repro? is it with streaming or batch path?
mina: streaming + kv caching enabled (default config). repro script attached below. quick run shows drift in generated text at step 8203.
carla: hmm what hardware? cuda/cuDNN versions? quant pipeline?
samir: model on int4 pipelined build from main branch, cuda 12.1, tf32 disabled. Tried both per-layer quant and fused int4 kernel.
mina: repro (python):
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(model=\"quant-m38b-int4\", streaming=True, kv_cache=True)
prompt = \"Tell a coherent story. \" + \"word \" * 8200
resp = c.generate(prompt)
print(resp.text[:1200])
```
jon: Nice and tiny. Can you also dump KV indices at the moment of divergence? a hex snapshot or sha?
mina: dumped sha256 of kv buffer at 8199 and 8204:
- 8199: 3f7a2b1c...
- 8204: 9d4b8f22...
(suspiciously different)
carla: Does the index jump align with a RoPE wrap/scale adjustment? any logs showing rotary position scaling firing?
samir: adding logs from runtime:
```
[2026-02-11T14:12:33Z] layer-12: pos_scale_check: no-op
[2026-02-11T14:12:33Z] layer-23: pos_scale_check: apply_scale factor=0.9987
[2026-02-11T14:12:34Z] kv: flush_hint triggered at seq=8200
```
carla: flush_hint at 8200 + pos_scale change at 23 looks like a handshake mismatch — cache entries not adjusted for the scaling change. Could cause token aliasing.
mina: I ran a quick fuzz: disabling posscale smoothing removes drift. With smoothing enabled, drift appears.
jon: So two hypotheses: 1) posscale adjustment isn't applied to cached KV shards during flush/merge; 2) stitching code assumes stable phase and skips reapply.
mina: I pushed a tiny instrumented build to my branch: https://github.com/redwood/infer/commit/ba9c2f (link). deploy-bot: can we run canary on dedicated pool nimbus-30?
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled on nimbus-30 pool, job id deploy-8821. ETA ~12m. :white_check_mark;
carla: If canary reproduces, next would be to either rebase posscale before KV merge or add scaled-copy step during handshake. Preference for rebase to limit extra copies.
samir: also worth checking quantized kernel alignment — int4 packing might make in-place scaling lossy for certain shard offsets.
jon: Good catch. Mina, can you attach a short golden prompt that demonstrates semantic shift? We should add to longctx regression suite.
mina: done — adding to repo/tests/longctx/goldens/rope-handshake-shift.txt and creating an eval. Quick diff shows BLEU drop ~0.06 after 8k.
carla: Cool. If canary is green, we can schedule a targeted fix. If it reproduces, prioritize rebase-on-merge approach + unit test.
mina: Thanks — will monitor deploy output and post logs. :thumbsup;
jon: Thanks, team. Keep updates here.
deploy-bot: Canary finished: 1/5 instances reproed the drift, logs uploaded to s3://redwood-logs/ci/deploy-8821/8200-drift.log
mina: grabbing logs now.
